title: Israel's Shepherd, Guide Me, Feed Me
description: Israel's Shepherd, Guide Me, Feed Me in Tonic Solfa to ALL FOR JESUS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: Edward Bickersteth wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 84 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Closing Hymn”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ALL FOR JESUS; any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Is-rael's Shep-herd, guide me, feed me. Through my pil-grim-age be-low, And be-side the wa-ters lead me, Where thy flock re-joic-ing go.

lines: Israel's Shepherd, guide me, feed me.
And beside the waters lead me,
I have found thee, and would never,

licence: Public domain: Edward Bickersteth died in 1850.
credits: Words by Edward Bickersteth (1786–1850), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ALL FOR JESUS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
